decisions.reason: The yogurt sits very close to the core organic dairy range and its earlier award-based validation suggests it is likely a steady assortment item rather than a withdrawal candidate.
As a prominently launched flagship-style cheese that fits the firm's core cheese competence, this product would normally be retained unless there were clear and persistent sales weakness.
The spicy cheese line matches the firm's cheese focus, but a multi-variant line is more exposed to portfolio simplification in a firm with a relatively narrow range.
This mild creamy soft cheese appears to fill a deliberate role in the assortment and should be kept, though it is somewhat vulnerable if management sharpens focus on the strongest sellers.
The washed-rind soft cheese is the most niche and potentially hardest-to-scale item among the surviving launches, so dropping it would fit a prudent focus on core volume products and new development.
